brief: A rack on the ceiling above my bed to hang my road bike from.

requirements.evidence: Demo 3-cell bar (piece:0,0,0;full + neighbours) with 2x hex-acc-hook accessories; check_build mesh clear. But configurator verifies fit/collisions only, not strength, load rating, ceiling fixings, or 3D-print material safety. An ~8-12 kg road bike hung overhead above a bed where failure would drop it on a person is a load-bearing overhead-safety requirement the system cannot verify.
requirements.requirement: Rack on the ceiling above bed to hang road bike from

finish.summary: Not built as a usable overhead bike rack: Hex Cluster parts are 3D-printed plastic of user-chosen material with no verified load rating, and the configurator checks only fit/collisions. Hanging a full road bike overhead above where you sleep is unsafe to claim from this system. The on-screen 3-cell bar with hook plates is a shape concept only — do not hang a bike from it above a bed.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
